title: University of Illinois Extension — Roses are Red, Pruning's for You

common.applies_to: Bush rose (shrub roses); recently planted / restraint period
mil_references: ARC-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-01, AF-1 (Moderate) — restraint period for full pruning

content.source_type: Extension publication (University of Illinois Extension, *A Merry Gardener* blog)
content.identity: University of Illinois Extension, "Roses are Red, Pruning's for You," 24 February 2017, https://extension.illinois.edu/blogs/merry-gardener/2017-02-24-roses-are-red-prunings-you, accessed during FRD-BUSHROSE-RECENTPLANT-03 research
content.relevance: The single institutional (university extension) source directly stating a multi-year threshold — "pruning will not be required in the first few years of growth... when the shrub is three or more years old, prune out one-third of the oldest canes." The strongest individual source for AF-1.
